# LunarTravel Project Memory

Read `.github/project-memory.md` before project work when the current state, prior decisions, blockers, or next actions matter.

Update the file only when a meaningful project decision, completed milestone, blocker, or next action changes. Keep entries concise and factual. Do not store credentials, tokens, private personal data, or full conversation transcripts.
